title: Formal unramifiedness data for the normalized root compositum
statement: Under the hypotheses of the uniformizer-root compositum theorem, the selected DVR T is an essentially finite type formally unramified A-algebra.

proof.text: Construct the intermediate root normalization, prove the unit-root etale calculation over U, use multiplicativity of ramification indices and residue separability, then descend through the arbitrary DVR base change A and identify the selected local factor with T.
